S07 E05 — Sailfish and Mahi With Top Chef Tom Colicchio in South Florida
Peter takes his friend and top chef, Tom Colicchio, out for sailfish and mahi-mahi off the coast of South Florida. Peter's son Maverick helps prepare mahi fingers for dinner.

title: Livin' the Dream With Captain Jimmy Nelson
description:
S09 E10 — Giant Snapper Smackdown Pt 2
Livin' the Dream follows Captain Jimmy Nelson and his wife Luiza as they travel and fish in exotic locales.

title: George Poveromo's World of Saltwater Fishing
description:
S25 E10 — The Cudjoe Two-Step: Cudjoe, Lower Florida Keys
George Poveromo splits his day between anchoring for yellowtails and trolling within Hawk Channel off Cudjoe in the lower Florida Keys.

title: Saltwater Underground With Nick Honachefsky
description:
Key West Slamboree
A ride catching high-flying sailfish, blackfin tuna, yellow jacks, yellowtail snapper, mutton snapper, giant barracuda and more with Match Point Charters Capt. Jack Walker in Key West.

title: Unfathomed
description:
S08 E10 — Sarasota Slam
Follow Capt. George in search of fish and adventure.

title: The Fish Guyz
description:
S06 E05 — Gulf Expedition, Part 2
The Guyz hop in the 44-foot Contender with The Nature Conservancy's David Moss for a trip out into the Gulf of Mexico; George and Lain learn about rising sea levels; chef Cat shares her recipe for shrimp and grits.

title: Spear Life
description:
S07 E09 — Diving For Giant Meg Teeth
The Spear Life crew joins Captain Cameron Sebastian and Brittany Sebastian off Myrtle Beach, South Carolina, in a search for giant Megalodon teeth before switching gears for wreck diving, spearfishing, and a memorable hook-and-cook.

title: Julie Higgs Spearfishing
description:
S01 E02 — Wreck full of monsters
Julie, Luis, Derek, and Milan spearfish big snapper off a wreck in Costa Rica.
